title: Overview
text: Section 1 • Executive Overview Why Genomic Equity Matters & Blueprint Selection Fixing EUR-biased calibration, SAS/AFR VUS burden, HBB_E7V sickle-cell false-benign traps, and DPDP Act 2023/2025 hospital data sovereignty. Clinical & Regulatory Problem Clinical VEPs trained on European cohorts miscalibrate South Asian (SAS) and African (AFR) patients and falsely call balancing-selection alleles like Sickle Cell ( HBB_E7V ) benign. Cloud SaaS suites also conflict with India's DPDP Act 2023/2025 . Genomic Equity Conformal runs 100% air-gapped on free CPU. Why Track 7 Was Selected Over 3 Competing Blueprints Blueprint Core Scope Free-Tier Fit Decision Track 7 (Genomic Equity) Frozen ESM-2 + AlphaMissense CC BY 4.0 + Nested OOF Platt + Non-Empty Mondrian ~10 core-h/mo, 507–629 MB RAM, $0 validation BUILT (v1.0.0) Track 2 (AMR Gram-Neg) Multi-task Chemprop D-MPNN + Mondrian + Vina ~18 core-h/mo; needs $1.5k–$2k wet-lab grant BACKUP TRACK OpenRepurpose-CPU AlphaFold v6 + ProDy + fpocket/P2Rank + Vina + RO-Crate ~11.6 core-h/target; lighter ML/DL depth HYBRID ADD-ON Fungal Pma1 & OpenStax Unaudited Pma1 draft; Biology 2e review Assumed 8-core/16 GB; biophysical/patent flaws REJECTED
